I guess this action is doing only a workflow dispatch? The corresponding `curl` would be something close to

```
payload='{
  "ref": "${{ env.TARGET_BRANCH }}",
  "inputs": {
  }
}'

curl -L \
  -X POST \
  -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${{ secrets.bearer }}"\
  -H "X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28" \ https://api.github.com/repos/YOUR_ORG/YOUR_REPO/actions/workflows/YOUR_ACTION.yaml/dispatches \
  -d "$payload"
```
